title: SSF Constable Barber Washerman Bharti 2026 – 10 Posts, 10th Pass Online Apply
description: Secretariat Security Force yaani SSF ne Constable Barber aur Constable Washerman ke 10 posts ke liye official notification jari ki hai. SSF Ministry of Home Affairs ke under kaam karti hai. Yeh ek central government ki permanent naukri hai jo Level-2 pay scale mein aati hai. 10th pass yuvaon ke liye yeh ek bahut achha mauka hai sarkari naukri paane ka. SSF Constable Bharti 2026 – Vibhag Ki Jaankari Secretariat Security Force ek Central Armed Police Force hai jo Mantralaya aur government secretariat buildings ki suraksha karta hai. Is force mein kaam karne wale Constable ko sarkari officials aur buildings ki raksha karni hoti hai. Yeh posts permanent nature ki hain aur isme service conditions Central Government employees jaise hi hote hain. Pension, DA, HRA jaise sab benefits milte hain. Posts Aur Vacancies Is bharti mein do tarah ki posts hain. Pehli post Constable Barber hai jiske liye 3 seats hain. Doosri post Constable Washerman hai jiske liye 7 seats hain. Kul 10 posts hain aur yeh sirf Male Indian citizens ke liye hain. Vacancies badh ya ghatt bhi sakti hain — is liye official website regularly check karo. Pay Scale Aur Salary Select honewale candidates ko 7th Central Pay Commission ke Level-2 pay matrix ke hisaab se Rs. 19,900 se Rs. 63,200 tak monthly salary milegi. Iske saath Dearness Allowance, HRA ya free quarters, Transport Allowance, Leave Travel Concession aur Central Government ke baaki allowances bhi milenge. New Pension Scheme bhi applicable hai. Eligibility – Kaun Apply Kar Sakta Hai? Shaikshik Yogyata mein Matriculation yaani 10th pass kisi bhi recognized Board, School ya Institution se hona zaroori hai. Sirf certificate hona kaafi nahi — Trade Test bhi pass karna hoga jisme haircutting, massage ya kapde dhona aur ironing ki practical skills test hoti hai. Aayu Seema 18 se 23 saal tak hai jo closing date 28 April 2026 ke hisaab se calculate hogi. Matlab janm 29 April 2003 se 28 April 2008 ke beech hona chahiye. SC ke liye 5 saal, OBC ke liye 3 saal ki chhoot milegi. Ex-Servicemen ke liye bhi relaxation available hai. Physical Standards Lambaai General category ke liye 170 cm chahiye. Pahadi ilaqon jaise Garhwal, Kumaon, Gorkha, Dogra, Maratha, Assam, Himachal Pradesh, Kashmir ke liye 165 cm. North-East states ke liye 162.5 cm. Scheduled Tribes ke liye 160 cm. Seena General ke liye bina phoolay 80 cm aur phoolay hue 85 cm hona chahiye. Aankhon ki roshni 6/6 honi chahiye bina chashme ke. Ghutne modna, flat foot, varicose veins ya aankhon mein squint nahi hona chahiye. Application Fee General, OBC aur EWS candidates ke liye Rs. 100 ki fee lagegi. SC aur Ex-Servicemen ke liye koi fee nahi hai. Fee sirf online payment gateway se deni hogi recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in par. Doosre kisi bhi tarike se fee dene par application reject ho jaayegi. Selection Process Ke 4 Phases Phase 1 mein Physical Efficiency Test hoga jisme 1.6 km race 7 minute 30 second mein, 11 feet long jump aur 3.5 feet high jump 3-3 mauka dekar test hoga. Ex-Servicemen ke liye PET nahi hoga. Phir Physical Standard Test mein height, chest aur weight check hogi. Phase 2 mein Written Examination hoga — 50 marks ka 1 ghante ka paper. General Awareness se 15, Mathematics se 10, Analytical Aptitude se 15 aur English/Hindi se 10 marks ke objective questions honge. Negative marking nahi hai. Phase 3 mein Trade Test hoga jo 50 marks ka hoga. Barber ke liye haircutting ke 20 marks, massage ke 15 marks, aur tools ki knowledge ke 15 marks. Washerman ke liye kapde dhone ke 15, ironing ke 10, dry cleaning ke 10 aur detergents ki knowledge ke 15 marks. Phase 4 mein Document Verification aur Detailed Medical Examination hogi. Apply Kaise Karein? recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in par jaayein. ITBPF portal par nayi profile banayein. Category, personal aur educational details bilkul sahi bharein. Documents upload karein. Rs. 100 fee online pay karein agar applicable ho. Form submit karein aur printout rakhein. Last date 28 April 2026 hai.

title: NIC Scientist B Bharti 2026 – 243 Posts ke liye Apply Karein, GATE Score Zaroori

GATE 2024, 2025 ya 2026 ka valid score rakhne wale engineering graduates ke liye yeh ek sunehri mauka hai. Is bharti ke zariye Computer Sciences & IT, Electronics & Communication aur Data Science & AI teeno streams mein 243 permanent posts bhare jaayenge. Yeh posts Group-A Gazetted category mein hain aur 7th Pay Commission ke Level-10 pay scale par milti hain jisme basic pay Rs. 56,100 se lekar Rs. 1,77,500 tak hoti hai. Electronics & Communication ke liye B.E./B.Tech Electronics & Communication mein hona chahiye aur GATE EC paper code ka score hona chahiye. Fee online mode se pay karni hogi. Selection Process Kya Hai? NIC Scientist B mein selection GATE score ke basis par shortlisting ke baad Personal Interaction yaani interview ke zariye hoga. GATE score aur interview performance ka combined score final merit tay karega. Document verification ke baad joining di jaayegi. Apply Kaise Karein? Online apply karne ke liye recruitment.nic.in par jaayein. Naya account banayein ya existing account se login karein. Apna GATE score aur educational details sahi bharein. Documents upload karein. Fees online pay karein. Form submit karke printout lein. Last date 24 April 2026 hai isliye aaj hi apply karein.

description:
SSC JE Junior Engineer Tier-II Exam City Details 2026 — Poori Jaankari

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) ne Junior Engineer (JE) Examination 2025 ke Tier-II ke liye Exam City Details 27 March 2026 ko official website ssc.gov.in par jari kar diya hai. Jo candidates Paper-I mein qualify ho chuke hain, unka Tier-II exam 07 April 2026 ko hoga. Admit Card 04 April 2026 tak available hone ki sambhavana hai. Isliye sabhi qualified candidates apni exam city abhi check karein aur yatra ki taiyari pehle se karein.

SSC JE Bharti 2025 Kya Hai?

SSC Junior Engineer ek prestigious central government recruitment hai jisme Civil, Mechanical aur Electrical engineering graduates aur diploma holders ke liye 1731 posts hain. Yeh posts Central Water Commission, CPWD, Border Road Organization, Military Engineer Services, Farrakka Barrage, Water Resources Ministry aur NTRO mein hain. Pay Level-6 mein ₹35,400 se ₹1,12,400 milte hain.

ssc.gov.in par jaayein aur Login button pe click karein. Registration Number aur Password enter karein. Captcha fill karein aur Submit karein. Download karein aur printout lein.

Puri Timeline

Online Apply Start: 30 June 2025. Last Date: 21 July 2025. Tier-I Exam: 03-06 December 2025. Answer Key: 19 December 2025. Result: 06 March 2026. Tier-II Exam City: 27 March 2026 Available. Tier-II Admit Card: 04 April 2026 Expected. Tier-II Exam Date: 07 April 2026.

Age Limit aur Eligibility

Maximum age 30-32 saal hai (01 August 2025 ke hisab se). JE Civil ke liye Civil Engineering Degree/Diploma. JE Mechanical ke liye Mechanical Engineering Degree/Diploma. JE Electrical ke liye Electrical Engineering Diploma. Kuch posts mein 2 saal work experience bhi maanga jaata hai.

Selection Process

Tier-I Exam (CBT), Tier-II Exam (Descriptive Paper), Document Verification aur Final Merit List se selection hota hai.

Admit Card mein exam center ka address Google Maps se pehle se check kar lein. Exam day 30 minute pehle pahunchen. Valid photo ID saath rakhein. Mobile, calculator ya smartwatch hall mein allowed nahi. SSC helpline 011-69999845 par call kar sakte hain kisi bhi problem ke liye.

SarthakYojana.in par aapko SSC JE aur baaki sabhi sarkari naukri ki latest updates milti rahegi. Bookmark karein aur daily visit karein.

title: MPESB Forest Guard, Jail Prahari & Field Guard Bharti 2026 – 1679 Posts ke liye Apply Karein
description: Madhya Pradesh mein sarkari naukri ki talash kar rahe yuvaon ke liye ek acha mauka aaya hai. Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board yaani MPESB ne Forest Guard, Field Guard, Jail Prahari aur Assistant Jail Superintendent ke kul 1679 posts ke liye bharti nikali hai. Yeh bharti un sabhi ke liye hai jo 10th pass hain ya graduation kar chuke hain aur MP sarkar mein naukri karna chahte hain. Is bharti ki sabse khaas baat yeh hai ki isme male aur female dono apply kar sakte hain. Aur last date ko extend karke 30 April 2026 kar diya gaya hai, isliye jin logo ne abhi tak apply nahi kiya unke paas abhi bhi waqt hai. Vacancy Details — Kitne Posts Hain? Is bharti mein 4 alag-alag posts ke liye selection hoga. Sabse zyada 757 posts Jail Prahari ke hain, uske baad 728 posts Forest Guard ke, 169 posts Field Guard ke aur 25 posts Assistant Jail Superintendent ke hain. Aayu Seema — Kaun Apply Kar Sakta Hai? Is bharti mein apply karne ke liye minimum age 18 saal rakhi gayi hai. Assistant Jail Superintendent ke liye minimum age 21 saal hai. Maximum age general category ke male candidates ke liye 33 saal hai. Mahilaon aur reserved category ke MP ke rehne wale candidates ko 5 saal ki chhoot milti hai yani unke liye maximum age 38 saal hai. Age limit 1 January 2026 ke hisaab se nikalenge. Application Fee — Kitna Paisa Lagega? General category aur doosre state ke candidates ko 560 rupaye fees deni hogi. MP ke SC, ST, OBC aur PwD candidates ke liye fees 310 rupaye hai. Is fees mein 60 rupaye portal charge bhi shamil hai. Payment MP Online ke authorized kiosk centers par cash mein ya Debit Card, Credit Card aur Net Banking se bhi kar sakte hain. Physical Fitness — Kitni Height aur Chest Chahiye? Yeh ek physical post hai isliye body measurements bhi check ki jaati hain. Jail Prahari ke liye male candidates ki height 165 cm aur chest 83 cm honi chahiye. Mahilaon ke liye 158 cm height kaafi hai. Forest Guard aur Field Guard male candidates ke liye height 163 cm, chest 79 cm aur chest expansion 5 cm hona zaruri hai. Mahilaon ke liye Forest Guard aur Field Guard mein 150 cm height chahiye. Assistant Jail Superintendent male ke liye 168 cm height aur 84 cm chest chahiye. Mahilaon ke liye 155 cm height kaafi hai. Documents — Kya Kya Lagega? Apply karte waqt aapke paas Aadhaar Card, 10th ka certificate aur marksheet, graduation certificate agar applicable ho, caste certificate agar OBC/SC/ST hain, ek recent passport size photo, signature aur valid email ID aur mobile number hona chahiye. Inhe sahi format mein scan karke ready rakhein. Apply Kaise Karein — Step by Step? Sabse pehle MPESB ki official website par jaayein. Wahan Forest Guard Bharti 2026 wala link dhundhein. Pehle ESB Profile banani hogi agar pehle se nahi bani hai. Phir Rojgar Panjiyan bhi zaroori hai. Profile banne ke baad online form mein apni details bharein — personal info, educational details, physical measurements sab. Documents upload karein. Fee pay karein. Submit karne ke baad form ka printout zaroor lein. Selection Process Kya Hoga? Is bharti mein selection written exam, physical test aur medical test ke zariye hoga. Physical test mein running, pull-ups aur long jump jaise tests honge. Jo candidates physical aur written dono mein pass honge, unhe medical ke liye bulaya jaayega. Final merit list ke baad joining letter milega.

title: Indian Army Agniveer Rally Bharti 2026 – GD, Technical, Sepoy Pharma ke liye Apply Karein
description: Bharat ki Sena mein jaana bahut se youngsters ka sapna hota hai aur ab us sapne ko poora karne ka waqt aa gaya hai. Join Indian Army ne Agniveer Rally Bharti 2026-27 ke liye notification jari ki hai. Is bharti ke through GD, Technical, Tradesman, Nursing Assistant, Sepoy Pharma aur JCO Religious Teacher jaise posts ke liye selection hoga. Is bharti ki khaas baat yeh hai ki yeh ek Rally-based recruitment hai, matlab selected states aur districts mein physical tests aur written exams dono ek saath conduct ki jaati hain. Isliye apne district ki rally date zaroor check karein. Ye Bharti Kya Hai — Agniveer Scheme Kya Hoti Hai? Agniveer scheme ke tahat candidates ko 4 saal ke liye Army mein seva ka mauka milta hai. In 4 saalon mein candidates ko achhi training, salary aur anubhav milta hai. 4 saal baad kuch selected Agniveers ko regular Army mein liya jaata hai baki ko ek mota severance package diya jaata hai jisse woh apna khud ka kaam ya aage padhai kar sakte hain. Yeh scheme un yuvaon ke liye bahut faydemand hai jo desh seva karna chahte hain. Post Wise Eligibility Kya Hai? Agniveer GD ke liye candidates ko apne us district ka niwasi hona zaroori hai jahan se woh rally mein apply kar rahe hain. Class 10th pass hona chahiye minimum. Height 169 cm aur 1.6 km running 5 minute 30 second mein karni hogi. Pull-ups 10 baar lagane honge. Women Military Police ke liye Agniveer GD mahilaaon ke liye ek alag category hai. Inhe 10th mein 45 percent marks chahiye. Height 162 cm honi chahiye aur 1.6 km running 7 minute 30 second mein karni hogi. Nursing Assistant ke liye candidates ke paas 12th mein Physics, Chemistry aur Biology ke saath 50 percent marks hone chahiye. Height 169 cm se 170 cm post ke hisaab se alag hoti hai. Sepoy Pharma ke liye 12th ke baad D.Pharma ya B.Pharma kiya hua hona chahiye aur Pharmacy Council mein registration bhi hona chahiye. JCO Religious Teacher ke liye Pandit, Granthi, Maulvi, Padre ya Buddhist Monk ki post ke hisaab se graduation ke saath relevant religious qualification chahiye. Aayu Seema — Kya Age Chahiye? Agniveer GD, Technical, Assistant aur Tradesman ke liye age 17.5 saal se 22 saal honi chahiye. Soldier Technical ke liye 17.5 se 23 saal. Sepoy Pharma ke liye 19 se 25 saal. JCO Religious Teacher ke liye 25 se 34 saal ki age honi chahiye. Application Fee — Kitni Lagegi? Is bharti ke liye General, OBC aur EWS sabhi categories ke liye 250 rupaye ki fees hai. SC aur ST candidates ke liye bhi 250 rupaye hi hai. Payment UPI, net banking, debit ya credit card se online ki ja sakti hai. Physical Test Ki Taiyari Kaise Karein? Army ki rally mein physical fitness bahut zaroori hai. Running ki preparation ke liye roz subah jaldi utho aur 4 se 5 km ki practice karo. Pull-ups ke liye regular exercises karo. Apni height ke hisaab se weight balance rakho. Achi diet lo aur neend poori karo. Admit card milte hi apne documents ready rakh lo aur rally venue par samay se pahuncho. Apply Kaise Karein? Sabse pehle Indian Army ki official website par jaayein. Wahan Agniveer Rally ka link dhundhein. Pehle new registration karein. Login karke apni post select karein. Personal details, educational details aur district details bharein. Photo aur documents upload karein. Fee pay karein. Final submit ke baad application print kar lein.

MP Police Head Quarter yaani MPPHQ ne Forensic Science Laboratory mein 126 posts ke liye recruitment notice jari kiya hai. In posts mein Laboratory Technician, Laboratory Assistant aur Laboratory Attendant shamil hain. Sabse achhi baat yeh hai ki is bharti mein kisi bhi category ke liye koi application fees nahi hai — yani bilkul free mein apply kar sakte hain. Yeh MP ke un students ke liye sone pe suhaga hai jo science se graduation ya 12th kar chuke hain. Kya Kaam Karna Hoga In Posts Mein? Forensic Science Laboratory mein kaam karna matlab aap police ki jaanch mein scientific taur par madad karenge. Crime scene se laaye gaye samples ka analysis karna, reports taiyar karna aur evidence preserve karna — yeh sab in posts ki zimmedaari hai. Yeh kaam bahut responsible aur important hota hai kyunki scientific reports court mein bhi use hoti hain. Post Wise Vacancy Aur Qualification Kya Chahiye? Laboratory Technician ke liye 35 posts hain. Laboratory Assistant ke liye 33 posts hain aur iske liye 12th Science stream se pass hona kaafi hai. Laboratory Attendant ke liye 58 posts hain jo 10th pass candidates ke liye hain. Teen posts mein se kisi ek ke liye bhi apply kar sakte hain apni qualification ke hisaab se. Age Limit Kya Hai? Is bharti ke liye minimum age 18 saal aur maximum age 40 saal hai. Apply karne ke liye Aadhaar Card, 10th aur 12th ki marksheet aur certificate, graduation certificate agar applicable ho, caste certificate, domicile certificate, ek recent passport size photo aur signature scan ready rakhein. Sab documents sahi format mein hone chahiye. Apply Kaise Karein? Sabse pehle official website par jaayein aur registration karein. Login ke baad application form mein sari details achi tarah se bharein. Educational details mein koi gadbad na karo. Documents upload karein. Form ka preview dekho — sab sahi hai toh submit karo. Submit ke baad receipt zaroor download karein aur ek printout nikaalo rakh lo.

title: Bihar Board 10th 12th Result 2026 – BSEB Matric aur Intermediate Result Kaise Dekhen
description: Bihar mein laakhon students ka intezaar khatam hone wala hai. Bihar School Examination Board yaani BSEB jald hi 10th Matric aur 12th Intermediate ka result announce karne wala hai. Agar aap bhi Bihar Board ke student hain toh yeh jaankari aapke kaam ki hai — result kaise dekhen, kya kya chahiye aur kahan check karein. Har saal Bihar Board ka result lakhs of students ki zindagi ka ek important padaav hota hai. 10th result ke baad aage ki stream chunni hoti hai aur 12th result ke baad college admissions start hote hain. Isliye result ka intezaar students aur parents dono ko bahut eagerly rehta hai. Result Kab Tak Aayega? Bihar Board ka 12th Intermediate result March 2026 mein aane ki ummeed hai. 10th Matric ka result March ya April 2026 mein aayega. Yeh dates expected hain — official announcement board ki website par ki jaayegi. Exam February 2026 mein conduct hua tha. Result Kaise Check Karein — Step by Step? Result check karne ke liye sabse pehle Bihar Board ki official website results.biharboardonline.com par jaana hoga. Wahan 10th ya 12th result ka link dhundhein. Link par click karne ke baad aapka Roll Code aur Roll Number daalna hoga — yeh aapke admit card par likhe hote hain. Phir captcha fill karo aur submit karo. Aapka result screen par aa jaayega. Result ka screenshot lo ya PDF download karo aur ek printout nikaalo. Marksheet Mein Kya Likha Hoga? Result mein student ka naam, roll number, roll code, pitaji aur mataji ka naam, subject-wise marks, total marks, division ya grade aur pass ya fail status likha hoga. Online marksheet provisional hoti hai — original marksheet school ke through milegi. Passing Marks Kitne Chahiye? Bihar Board mein pass hone ke liye har subject mein minimum 33 percent marks laane zaroori hain. Practical wale subjects mein practical mein bhi alag se pass karna hota hai. Agar kisi subject mein marks kam aayen toh scrutiny aur compartment exam ka option bhi hota hai. Scrutiny aur Compartment Exam Kya Hota Hai? Agar aapko lagta hai ki kisi subject mein marks galat aaye hain toh result aane ke ek hafte baad scrutiny form bhar sakte hain. Yeh online process hoti hai aur fees bhi lagti hai. Agar kisi subject mein fail ho jaayein toh compartment exam dene ka mauka milta hai jo April ya May 2026 mein expected hai. Compartment result June-July mein aayega. Agar Result Check Karte Waqt Server Down Hojaye? Result ke din lakhs of students ek saath website kholta hain jisse server overload ho jaata hai. Aise mein kuch der baad dobara try karein. Third-party websites jaise indiaresults.com par bhi result check kar sakte hain. Mobile data aur wifi dono try karo.

title: JEE Main 2026 Session 2 – Exam City Jari, April mein Hoga Exam
description: Engineering mein career banana chahne wale students ke liye JEE Main 2026 Session 2 ka notification aagaya hai. National Testing Agency yaani NTA ne April 2026 mein JEE Main Session 2 conduct karne ka schedule jari kar diya hai. Exam city details bhi release ho gayi hain — matlab jo candidates apply kar chuke hain woh ab jaanne lage hain ki unka exam center kahan hoga. JEE Main ek national level entrance exam hai jo engineering colleges mein admission ke liye hota hai. IITs mein admission ke liye JEE Advanced dena padta hai lekin uske liye pehle JEE Main clear karna zaroori hai. NIT, IIIT aur central funded technical institutions mein direct JEE Main score se admission hota hai. Session 2 Kyun Important Hai? JEE Main ke 2 sessions hote hain. Jo students Session 1 mein achha score nahi kar paaye unke liye Session 2 ek aur mauka hai. Dono sessions ke best score ko consider kiya jaata hai. Agar Session 1 nahi diya tha toh bhi Session 2 de sakte hain — dono independent hain. Eligibility Kya Hai? JEE Main 2026 mein apply karne ke liye koi age limit nahi hai. Candidate ko 2024, 2025 mein 12th pass hona chahiye ya 2026 mein appear karna chahiye. Jo 2023 ya usse pehle 12th pass kar chuke hain woh eligible nahi hain. Minimum marks ki bhi koi compulsion nahi hai. Application Fee Kitni Hai? Sirf Paper 1 ke liye General male candidates ko 1000 rupaye, OBC/EWS males ko 900 rupaye, General/OBC females ko 800 rupaye aur SC/ST/PwD ko 500 rupaye fees deni hoti hai. Paper 1 aur Paper 2 dono ke liye General/OBC/EWS males ko 2000 rupaye, females ko 1600 aur SC/ST/PwD ko 1000 rupaye dene honge. Payment Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking ya e-challan se hoti hai. Exam City Notice Kaise Dekhen? Jo candidates pehle se apply kar chuke hain woh NTA ki official website par login karke apni exam city check kar sakte hain. Exam city notice mein aapka exam center ka sheher likha hota hai lekin exact venue admit card mein aata hai. Admit card exam se 3-4 din pehle website par available hota hai. Preparation Tips for Session 2? Session 2 April 2026 mein hai — abhi thoda waqt hai. NCERT books ko ek baar aur achhe se padho especially Physics aur Chemistry ke formulas. Previous year questions solve karo. Mock tests regularly do taaki time management acchi ho. Weak topics par zyada dhyan do aur strong topics repeat karo.

title: Vehicle RC Card Online Download Kaise Karein – Parivahan aur DigiLocker se Puri Jaankari
description: Agar aapके paas koi bhi gaadi hai — chahe bike ho, car ho ya koi bhi commercial vehicle — toh RC yaani Registration Certificate ek bahut zaroori document hai. Sadak par chalte waqt traffic police RC maang sakti hai aur agar RC nahi dikhaye toh chaklan kat sakta hai. Ab achhi baat yeh hai ki RC online download ki ja sakti hai aur digital RC bhi legally valid hoti hai. RC ek sarkari document hai jo yeh sabit karta hai ki aapki gaadi sahi taur par sarkar ke paas registered hai. Isme gaadi ka number, malik ka naam, engine number, chassis number sab kuch likha hota hai. RC Mein Kya Kya Likha Hota Hai? RC mein gaadi ka registration number, malik ka poora naam aur pata, gaadi ka type, brand aur model, engine number, chassis number, manufacturing year, fuel type, registration date, RTO ka naam, gaadi ka rang aur fitness validity sab kuch hota hai. Commercial gaadion mein bima ki validity aur PUC status bhi RC mein dikhta hai. RC Kyun Zaroori Hai? RC ke bina aap gaadi nahi bech sakte, loan nahi le sakte, bima claim nahi kar sakte aur traffic police ke samne apni gaadi ki validity nahi sabit kar sakte. Chori ya accident mein bhi RC se pehchan hoti hai. Isliye RC hamesha safe rakhein. Parivahan Website se RC Kaise Download Karein? Sabse pehle parivahan.gov.in par jaayein. Wahan Online Services mein jaake Vehicle Related Services chunein. Apna state select karein. RC Print ya Duplicate RC ka option chunein. Gaadi ka registration number aur chassis number ke last 5 digits daalen. OTP verify karein. RC download ho jaayegi. DigiLocker se RC Kaise Download Karein? DigiLocker app ya website par jaayein. Mobile number ya Aadhaar se login karein. Search Documents mein RC search karein. Ministry of Road Transport and Highways ka option chunein. Registration number daalen aur OTP verify karein. RC aapke DigiLocker mein save ho jaayegi. Digital RC Legal Hai Ya Nahi? Haan, bilkul legal hai. Supreme Court aur Government of India ne digital documents ko physical documents ke barabar maanyata di hai. Traffic police ke samne DigiLocker ya mParivahan app par dikhayi gayi RC puri tarah valid hai. Isko lekar pareshan hone ki koi zaroorat nahi. RC Kho Jaaye Toh Kya Karein? Agar physical RC kho jaaye toh FIR karwaayein. Uske baad local RTO mein jaayein aur Duplicate RC ke liye application dein. Form 26 fill karna hoga. Prescribed fees bhari jaayegi. 30 din ke andar duplicate RC mil jaati hai. Iske bich DigiLocker ki digital RC use kar sakte hain.

title: Ladli Bahna Yojana 2026 – 34vi Kisht Update, Kab Aayegi Kaise Check Karein
description:
Ladli Bahna Yojana 2026 — 34vi Kisht aur Puri Jaankari

Madhya Pradesh sarkar ki Ladli Bahna Yojana MP ki mahilaon ke liye ek bahut hi important scheme hai. Is scheme mein har registered mahila ko har mahine ₹1250 seedha bank account mein milte hain. Saal bhar mein yeh ₹15,000 bante hain. 34vi kisht ka intezaar kar rahi hain jo 22 March 2026 ke baad aane wali hai. Agar aapki abhi tak kisht nahi aayi ya status check karna chahti hain, toh is article mein puri jaankari di gayi hai.

Ladli Bahna Yojana Kya Hai?

Ladli Bahna Yojana Madhya Pradesh ke Mukhyamantri ne shuru ki thi taaki MP ki garib aur madhyam varg ki mahilaon ko aarthik sahayata mile. Is scheme mein pehle ₹1000 per month milte the jo baad mein badhakr ₹1250 per month ho gaye. MP mein lagbhag 1.29 crore mahilaon ko is yojana ka laabh mil raha hai. Yeh paisa seedha DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) se bank account mein aata hai.

Kaun Apply Kar Sakti Hai?

Ladli Bahna ke liye Madhya Pradesh ki permanent resident mahila honi chahiye. Umar 21 se 60 saal ke beech honi chahiye. Vivahit hona zaruri hai - talaakshuda, vidhwa aur parityakta mahilayein bhi eligible hain. Annual family income ₹2.5 lakh se kam honi chahiye. 5 acre se zyada zameen nahi honi chahiye. Income tax bhar rahi hon ya sarkari naukri mein hon woh eligible nahi hain.

34vi Kisht Kab Aayegi?

Ladli Bahna Yojana ki 34vi kisht March 2026 ke antim hafte ya April 2026 ki shuruat mein aane ki ummeed hai. Har mahine 10 se 15 tarikh ke beech kisht transfer hoti hai. Status check karne ke liye cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in par jaayein aur apna registered mobile number ya application number enter karein.

Status Check Kaise Karein?

Status check karna bahut aasaan hai. Pehle cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in par jaayein. Phir Application Status option click karein. Apna Ladli Behna Application Number ya Samagra ID ya registered mobile number enter karein. Captcha fill karein aur Submit karein. Aapki sabhi kiston ki history aur aane wali kisht ka status dikh jaayega.

Paisa Nahi Aaya Toh Kya Karein?

Agar aapki Ladli Bahna kisht nahi aayi toh pehle cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in par status check karein. Agar bank account ki problem hai toh apne bank mein jaayein aur update karein. Agar eKYC pending hai toh MP Online kiosk ya CSC center se karein. Agar phir bhi problem ho toh Helpline number 181 ya 0755-2700800 par call karein. Gram Panchayat sachiv se bhi madad le sakte hain.

Documents Jo Zaruri Hain

Ladli Bahna registration ya update ke liye Aadhaar card, Samagra ID, bank passbook, passport size photo aur mobile number zaruri hain. Talaakshuda ya vidhwa mahilayein sambandh ka proof bhi de sakti hain.

Aakhri Baat

Ladli Bahna Yojana MP sarkar ki ek bahut achhi pehel hai jo mahilaon ko seedha aarthik madad deti hai. Har mahine ₹1250 aane se ghar ka kharcha kuch kam hota hai. Agar aapka naam list mein nahi hai ya kisht nahi aa rahi toh official helpline se sampark karein. SarthakYojana.in par aapko saari sarkari yojanaon ki updated information milti rahegi.

title: REET Bharti 2026 – Rajasthan Teacher Eligibility Test, Full Details

title: NTA NEET UG Online Form 2026 – Medical Admission ke liye Apply Karein
description: Doctor banna chahne wale students ke liye NEET UG 2026 bahut important exam hai. National Testing Agency yaani NTA ne NEET UG 2026 ka notification jari kar diya hai. MBBS, BDS aur AYUSH courses mein admission ke liye NEET dena compulsory hai. NEET Kya Hai? NEET yaani National Eligibility cum Entrance Test ek national level medical entrance exam hai. Is exam mein Physics, Chemistry aur Biology se questions aate hain. Score ke basis par government aur private medical colleges mein admission milta hai. Eligibility Kya Hai? 12th mein Physics, Chemistry aur Biology hona zaroori hai minimum 50% marks ke saath. SC/ST/OBC ke liye 40%. Minimum age 17 saal honi chahiye. Attempts limit hatai ja chuki hai. Exam Pattern? 180 questions hote hain — 45 Physics, 45 Chemistry aur 90 Biology se. Har sahi jawab ke 4 marks aur galat ke liye 1 mark kata jaata hai. Exam offline pen-paper mode mein hota hai 3 ghante 20 minute mein. Taiyari Tips? NCERT books poori tarah padhna sabse important hai. Biology mein bahut zyada weight hoti hai — sabse pehle isko achi tarah cover karo. Physics ke formulas aur derivations yaad karo. Chemistry mein organic chemistry pe dhyan do. NEET mein Kitna Score Chahiye? Government MBBS college ke liye General category mein 600+ marks achhe maane jaate hain. OBC ke liye 550+ aur SC/ST ke liye 500+. Private colleges mein kam score par bhi admission mil sakta hai lekin fees zyada hoti hai. AIIMS aur JIPMER ke liye 650+ chahiye. NEET Counselling Kya Hoti Hai? NEET clear karne ke baad counselling hoti hai jisme rank ke hisaab se college aur seat allot hoti hai. MCC yaani Medical Counselling Committee all India quota ke liye counselling karti hai. State quota ke liye state counselling alag hoti hai. Attempts Limit? Pehle NEET mein 3 attempts ki limit thi lekin ab koi limit nahi hai. Age limit bhi hata di gayi hai. Jab tak eligible ho tab tak de sakte hain. Isliye jo pehli baar clear nahi kar paaye woh baar baar try kar sakte hain.

description: Footpath par ya thele pe dukaan lagane wale street vendors ke liye PM SVANidhi Yojana ek badi madad hai. Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi scheme ke tahat rehri-patri wale, chaat wale, sabzi wale, cobbler, chai wale aur doosre street vendors ko bank se loan mil sakta hai bina kisi guarantee ke. Yojana Kya Hai? Is yojana mein pehle 10000 rupaye ka loan milta hai. Samay par wapas karne par 20000 rupaye aur phir 50000 rupaye tak ka loan mil sakta hai. Interest rate bhi subsidized hai. Digital transactions karne par cashback bhi milta hai. Kaun Eligible Hai? Shabhi urban street vendors eligible hain jo 24 March 2020 se pehle se kaam kar rahe hain ya certificate of vending rakhte hain. Local municipal authority ka certificate hona zaroori hai ya letter of recommendation. Kaise Apply Karein? PMSVANidhi.mohua.gov.in par apply kar sakte hain. PM SVANidhi mein flexible repayment hai — agar temporary problem hai toh bank se baat kar sakte hain. Regular repayment par cashback milta hai. Default karne se credit score kharab hota hai isliye samay par wapas karo. Digital Transactions Ka Faayda? Jo vendors digital payments lete hain — UPI, QR code etc — unhe monthly cashback milta hai PM SVANidhi scheme mein. Yeh 200 rupaye se 1200 rupaye tak ho sakta hai transactions ke hisaab se. Isliye digital payments encourage kiye jaate hain. Certificate of Vending Kaise Milta Hai? Apne local municipal corporation ya nagarpalika mein jaayein. Vendor registration form bharo. Surveyed vendors ko certificate of vending milta hai. New vendors ko letter of recommendation bhi kaam aata hai.

description: Madhya Pradesh sarkar buzurgon, divyang logon aur vidhwa mahilaon ko har mahine pension deti hai. Social Security Pension Yojana ke tahat yeh pension seedha bank account mein aati hai. Agar aap ya aapke parivar mein koi eligible hain toh zaroor apply karein. Kis Kis Ko Milti Hai Pension? Vridhavastha Pension 60 saal se upar ke buzurgon ko milti hai jinka naam BPL list mein hai. Samagra portal par bhi correction ho sakta hai. Pension rokte hain toh lokayukt portal par complain kar sakte hain. Pension Kab Se Milegi? Application ke baad 1-2 mahine mein pension shuru ho jaati hai agar documents sahi hon. Pehle backlog ke saath poora paisa ek saath bhi aata hai kuch cases mein. Jan Seva Kendra se status track kar sakte hain. Pension Kitne Saal Milti Hai? Jab tak eligible hain tab tak milti hai. Vridhavastha pension zindagi bhar. Viklang pension disability certificate valid hone tak. Vidhwa pension dobara shaadi nahi hone tak milti hai. Har saal documents reverify hote hain kuch cases mein.

title: Jan Aadhaar Card Rajasthan 2026 – Online Apply aur Download Kaise Karein

title: NIB Bharti 2026 – Scientist, Junior Scientist aur 46 Posts ke liye Online Apply Karein
description: National Institute of Biologicals yaani NIB ek pradhan sarkari sanstha hai jo Ministry of Health & Family Welfare ke under kaam karti hai. NIB Noida, Uttar Pradesh mein sthit hai aur yeh biological products ki quality testing, standardization aur research mein kaam karti hai. Agar aap science field mein career banana chahte hain toh NIB Bharti 2026 ek bahut achha mauka hai. Kul 46 posts ke liye notification jari ki gayi hai. NIB Bharti 2026 – Kya Hai Yeh Naukri? NIB mein alag alag posts ke liye application maangi gayi hain. Scientist Grade-II ke 2 posts hain jo sabse senior post hai isme salary bhi sabse zyada milti hai. Scientist Grade-III Veterinary ke 1 post hai jo veterinary science background walon ke liye hai. Junior Scientist ke 12 posts hain jo Master's degree walon ke liye ek excellent opportunity hai. Laboratory Technician ke 25 posts hain jo sabse zyada hain aur Biology background wale apply kar sakte hain. Iske alawa Administrative Assistant ka 1 post, Junior Hindi Translator ka 1 post aur Assistant-II ke 2 posts bhi hain. Salary Kitni Milegi? NIB mein salary central government pay matrix ke hisaab se milti hai. Scientist Grade-II ko 78800 se 209200 rupaye per month milenge jo ek bahut hi attractive salary hai. Scientist Grade-III Veterinary ko 56100 se 177500 rupaye milenge. Junior Scientist ko 44900 se 142400 rupaye milenge. Administrative Assistant, Junior Hindi Translator aur Laboratory Technician ko 35400 se 112400 rupaye milenge. Assistant-II ko 19900 se 63200 rupaye milenge. In salaries ke saath central government ke allowances jaise HRA, TA, DA bhi milenge jo overall package aur bhi behtar bana deta hai. Eligibility – Kaun Apply Kar Sakta Hai? Har post ke liye alag alag qualification chahiye. Scientist Grade-II ke liye MBBS ya PG Medical degree plus 5 saal experience chahiye ya Master's degree plus 7 saal experience ya PhD plus 3 saal experience. Junior Scientist ke liye Master's degree relevant field mein plus 1 saal experience zaroori hai. Laboratory Technician ke liye B.Sc Biology ya B.Sc Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry hona chahiye saath mein DMLT diploma ya B.Sc Medical Lab Technology plus 1 saal experience. Assistant-II ke liye 12th pass with 50% marks aur computer typing speed 35 words per minute English ya 30 words per minute Hindi mein zaroori hai. Age Limit Kya Hai? Scientist Grade-II ke liye maximum age 45 saal hai. Scientist Grade-III Veterinary ke liye 35 saal. Junior Scientist, Administrative Assistant, Junior Hindi Translator aur Laboratory Technician ke liye maximum 30 saal. Assistant-II ke liye maximum 27 saal. SC/ST/OBC aur government employees ke liye age mein chhoot milegi Government of India ke niyamon ke hisaab se. Chunav Prakriya – Selection Process Kya Hai? NIB Bharti 2026 mein selection teen stages mein hogi. Pehle Computer Based Examination hogi jo objective type multiple choice format mein hogi. CBT pass karne ke baad Personal Discussion hogi jisme aapki communication skills aur subject knowledge test ki jaayegi. Administrative Assistant aur Assistant-II ke posts ke liye Skill Test bhi hogi jisme typing test shamil hai. Junior Hindi Translator ke liye Open Competitive Examination hogi jisme Paper-I aur Paper-II dono dene honge. Application Process – Kaise Apply Karein? NIB Bharti 2026 mein apply karne ki process poori tarah online hai. Sirf online application accept ki jaayegi. Application start date 9 March 2026 hai aur last date 8 April 2026 hai toh jaldi apply karein. nib.gov.in official website par jaayein aur application form fill karein. Sahi personal aur educational details bharein. Photo, signature aur certificates required format mein upload karein. Form submit karne ke baad application ka printout zaroor lein. Online application ke saath saath hard copy bhi 8 April 2026 tak bhejni hogi. North-Eastern Region ke candidates ke liye bhi last date same hai. Agar application mein koi galat jaankari di ya koi important cheez chhupa li toh service se terminated kiya ja sakta hai isliye sab sahi sahi bharein. Zaroori Tips – Apply Karne Se Pehle Yeh Jaroor Karein? Pehle official notification PDF download karein nib.gov.in se aur poori tarah padhen. Apni eligibility achhi tarah check karein. Documents ready rakhein jaise certificates, marksheets, experience letters. Photo aur signature prescribed size mein scan karein. Application fee agar laagu ho toh online pay karein. Last date ka intzaar na karein – aaj hi apply karein kyunki server pe load badh jaata hai last date ke paas.
